about.p1.zh: 本站汇总公开的第三方 AI 模型评测，用同一套标准比较各家模型的能力、成本和速度，并区分版本和推理强度（reasoning effort）。本站不自行跑分。

method.score.zh: 能力：Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1，由 9 项评测组成（知识工作、编程、科学、通用四类各占 25%），同分并列。v5.0.1 于 2026-11-03 发布，评测组成和权重与 v5.0 相同，只把 CritPt 按 v2 重新评分，所有模型都已重评。
method.score.en: Intelligence: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1, built from 9 evaluations (knowledge work, coding, science and general, 25% each); ties share a rank. v5.0.1, released 2026-11-03, keeps the same evaluations and weights as v5.0 but regrades CritPt (v2); all models were regraded.

method.cost.zh: 成本：只比较综合分达到门槛（默认 35 分）的配置，按 AA 跑完整套评测的平均单任务成本从低到高排序。
method.cost.en: Cost: only configurations meeting a score bar (35 by default), sorted by AA’s average cost per evaluation task, low to high.

method.speed.zh: 速度：采用 Artificial Analysis 性能基准 v3.0.0（2026 年 11 月 3 日公布）。切到速度排序时，默认只看综合分 ≥ 25 的配置，可一键显示全部。默认看单任务耗时：完成一道综合指数评测题平均要几分钟（输出 token 数 ÷ 输出速度，按指数权重平均，是估算值）。也可看输出速度（整次请求每秒输出的 token 数，含思考 token 和等待首个 token 的时间；服务端失败的请求按 0 计）和首个答案时间（发出请求到收到第一个答案 token 的秒数，含思考时间）。数值来自每个模型的代表端点（通常是厂商官方 API），取单次请求与多轮代理任务、过去 5 天的平均。新方法与旧方法测得的速度数据不能直接比较；Artificial Analysis 没有给出数值的配置留空。 AA 速度方法 ↗
method.speed.en: Speed: uses Artificial Analysis Performance Benchmarking v3.0.0 (published Nov 3, 2026). Speed sorts show only configurations scoring ≥ 25 by default; one click shows all. The default is time per task: the average minutes needed to finish one Intelligence Index task (output tokens ÷ output speed, weighted like the index; an estimate). You can also sort by output speed (output tokens per second over the whole request, counting thinking tokens and the wait for the first token; requests that fail on the provider’s side count as 0) or time to first answer token (seconds from sending a request to the first answer token, including thinking time). Values come from each model’s representative endpoint (usually the model maker’s own API), averaged over single requests and multi-turn agent tasks across the past 5 days. They can’t be compared directly with speed figures measured under the previous method; configurations Artificial Analysis hasn’t measured are left blank. AA speed methodology ↗

limits.p1.zh: 综合分不是 IQ 或正确率；评测偏重英文。成本是 AA 跑评测的花费，不是你每次提问的费用。速度在美国服务器上测得，不代表你所在地区的体验；单任务耗时是估算值，不是计时。
limits.p1.en: The score is not an IQ or accuracy rate, and the benchmarks lean toward English. Cost is what AA spent running the benchmark, not your per-prompt price. Speed is measured on US servers and may differ where you are; time per task is an estimate, not a stopwatch time.
